id: task_lc_001
capability: long_context_qa
difficulty_tier: 2
smoke_member: true
prompt: |
  Which section of the attached document defines the term "Filler"?
max_tokens: 128
dimension_weights: { answer_correctness: 1.0 }
grader_specs:
  - type: golden_answer
    version: 1
    weight_dimensions: { answer_correctness: 1.0 }
    spec:
      answers:
        - { value: "Section 12" }
attachments:
  - name: doc.txt
    content: |
      Section 12 defines the term "Filler".

  - type: rule_scan

    weight_dimensions: { constraint_compliance: 1.0 }
